plugins.description: Twenty skills and four specialized agents for productivity workflows and Swift/iOS development. Includes iter, writing, instruct-dev, sharpen, chat-migration, code-audit, azure-devops, swizzle, tdd, systematic-debugging, worktree, cws (cross-session working state), plus swift-dev hub with specialist skills (SwiftData, accessibility, Foundation Models ref/discipline/diagnostics, iOS 26 reference). SwiftUI, concurrency, testing, and performance skills replaced by external community skills (TwoStraws, Dimillian). Agents: researcher, verifier, orchestrator, editor.
